title: Preflight's record-as-you-go step goes before the briefing print, not after it
context: Task 6 step 4 said to insert the record-as-you-go instruction after the step that prints the resumption briefing, then renumber Stop. But the pre-existing test skill.preflight-presents-and-stops asserts the briefing is the second-to-last step with nothing after it but stopping, so the plan's placement turns a currently green test red. That test encodes the standing duty to stop on the briefing and wait, which is a real behavioural contract rather than an incidental assertion. The plan's own wording for the step also failed two skill censuses: it opened with State, which is not one of the six verbs the census allows, and contained when, a forbidden rule marker. The debrief step 3 wording contained never, also forbidden.
options: Follow the plan, place the step after the briefing print, and update skill.preflight-presents-and-stops to accept it
Place the step before the briefing print so the briefing stays second-to-last
Drop the record-as-you-go step from preflight
outcome: Placed before the briefing print, as step 9, so the briefing remains second-to-last and the stop-on-the-briefing contract is preserved unchanged. The plan's wording for both the preflight step and debrief step 3 was rewritten to pass the skill censuses. The code reviewer endorsed the placement departure and the conformance auditor ruled both departures justified on evidence. The plan was written without running the skill censuses against its own prescribed text.
